set.name: Copper Echo
set.mechanism: The sonar ping that returns your own signal: one thin ring sweeps out and a single copper dot comes back — an index that answers with your collection. A warm dark room for listening, paired with a restrained warm off-white light surface so the product stays software.
set.expression_move: The copper echo dot is the only saturated moment; everything else is near-black, bone or paper.
set.differs_by: Every competitor pairs a neutral sans with a corporate primary (Navidrome blue, Jellyfin cyan, Plex magenta, Ampache orange); this is the only warm dark room with a single deep-copper signal, now with a light surface that belongs to the same environment.

logo.concept: A sonar sweep and its echo, nothing more: an open ring and one copper dot. The mark is kept to two primitives so it survives every size and becomes the interface's signal language.

defaults_used.why: Echo Copper is the echo dot of the brand's namesake mechanism (Sonarly = sonar), not a clay or craft cue: a small signal, never a wash, measured 28 CIE76 from Ampache's #f8ac4c — the only warm competitor primary — and much deeper (L* 52 vs 70).
The ring is the sonar ping the brand is named for, not a container: it is open (60-degree gap at 3 o'clock) and carries the echo dot at its trailing end. No competitor on the shelf uses a ring mark.

Owner direction from the round-1 review: the light UI surface is deliberately a restrained warm off-white so the product keeps a light mode that belongs to the same environment as the warm dark ground. It is a UI surface, not a brand wash, and no competitor on the measured shelf uses a warm neutral.

rationale.claim: The light surface moved from pure white to a warm off-white (#F5F2EB) at owner direction, so the system reads as software with a warm dark mode rather than an all-dark product drifting toward retro hi-fi.
Echo Copper #B96A2E (L* 52.3) sits 28 CIE76 from Ampache's #f8ac4c and 35 from Plex's brand yellow — clear of the near-colour rule — and stays a small signal on both grounds.
Bricolage Grotesque carries display and text in one variable file (~126 KB); its I/l IoU 0.92 warning applies at small text sizes and is a known trade-off of the quirky cut.
The mark is kept to two primitives (open ring + dot) per owner direction: it must survive 16 px and become the interface's signal language rather than a decorated logo.

set.name: Signal Archive
set.mechanism: Your catalogue, found by a signal: the same open ring sweeps a thin copper catalogue line and lands on one item — A's sonar echo disciplined by editorial indexing; two typefaces, paper warmth, one controlled signal.
set.expression_move: One thin copper catalogue rule under the wordmark, repeated as the system's only divider.
set.differs_by: Keeps A's unowned warm-dark + deep-copper territory against the competitors' corporate primaries, and is the only refinement with a true light archival surface — no competitor on the shelf reads as warm paper and copper.

logo.concept: The echo mark set on its catalogue line: open ring and copper dot above a thin full-width copper rule — the sweep crossing the index, landing on one item.
logo.defect: Catalogue rule width and drop are a first pass (460 units at y=130); set to the real Bricolage advance width and below the y descender once the glyph table is built.

misuse.label: Don't move the echo — the dot returns to the sweep's trailing end
Don't close the gap — a closed ring is a spinner, not a ping

defaults_used.why: Echo Copper is the echo dot of the brand's namesake mechanism (Sonarly = sonar), not a clay or craft cue: a small signal, never a wash, measured 28 CIE76 from Ampache's #f8ac4c — the only warm competitor primary — and much deeper (L* 52 vs 70).

The paper #EEECE6 is an owner-specified colour from the round-1 review (the archival light surface of the Signal Archive direction), not a generated default; it is the direction's ground, paired with owner-specified ink #171513.
The ring is the sonar ping the brand is named for, not a container: it is open (60-degree gap at 3 o'clock) and carries the echo dot at its trailing end. No competitor on the shelf uses a ring mark.

rationale.claim: A × B synthesis per owner direction: A's ring-and-copper metaphor and colour, B's editorial catalogue discipline (paper, ink, ruled line, mono metadata), with copper kept to one signal and one accent.
Paper #EEECE6, ink #171513 and copper #B96A2E are the owner's specified Signal Archive colours; copper stays CIE76 28+ from every warm competitor primary.
rationale.source: owner spec + palette screen vs site/competitors.json

rationale.claim: Two typefaces only, per owner direction: Bricolage Grotesque carries personality in display and text; IBM Plex Mono (tabular by default) carries catalogue metadata, figures and codes — no third voice.

The thin copper catalogue rule under the wordmark instantiates the scan-line device in the mark itself and becomes the system's one divider; at 4 units on a 100-unit grid it stays a hairline at display sizes.

set.name: Copper Night
set.mechanism: The listening room after midnight: the same ring and copper echo pushed deeper — a blacker ground, heavy tracked capitals — borrowing Night Sweep's drama while the copper stays the only light in the room.
set.expression_move: The copper echo dot against the deepest ground of the three, under wide tracked capitals.
set.differs_by: Against the competitors' corporate primaries this keeps A's unowned warm-dark + deep-copper territory; within the refinement round it is the dramatic register the other two deliberately refuse to be.

logo.concept: The echo mark at night: same open ring and copper dot, set against a deeper black with wide heavy capitals — playback as the lit part of a dark room.

defaults_used.why: Echo Copper is the echo dot of the brand's namesake mechanism (Sonarly = sonar), not a clay or craft cue: a small signal, never a wash, measured 28 CIE76 from Ampache's #f8ac4c — the only warm competitor primary — and much deeper (L* 52 vs 70).
The ring is the sonar ping the brand is named for, not a container: it is open (60-degree gap at 3 o'clock) and carries the echo dot at its trailing end. No competitor on the shelf uses a ring mark.

rationale.claim: A restrained dose of the round-1 Night Sweep direction per owner review: a deeper ground (#0E0B09 vs #17130E), uppercase Bricolage 700 tracked +80, and no second accent — the drama comes from depth and tracking, not from lime.
Copper on the deeper ground keeps a measured 3:1+ separation (L* 52.3 accent vs L* 3.2 ground), so the echo dot stays visible without glow effects.
The mark is identical to the other refinements by design: one master ring-and-dot across all three temperatures, so the family reads as one identity with three registers.
